policy_findings.correction: I initially messaged the parent that generic policy might provide the operative nonpublic option. After the parent identified theMLST-specific page, I independently read it and retracted that suggestion. Prepare under the stricterMLST-specific policy; no universal raw-publication permission is inferred.
